expected_result: scripts/check-platform-shapes.ts publishes CONTROL_OUTCOME_LABELS and ROW_LABELS, derives every non-ordinary CONTROL label from the reported outcome via an exported `controlOutcomeLabel`, asserts the label set's cardinality against PLATFORM_SHAPE_OUTCOMES in both directions inside the gate itself, asserts each printed row's label against the failure entries beside it, and publishes six further mirror kinds so every reachable label is watched being printed. All thirteen cases then pass.
actual_result: Test Files 1 failed (1). Tests 13 failed | 12 passed (25). Every failure names the planned behaviour and nothing else: `the CONTROL label set … expected +0 to be 13` and `the derivation was not exported: expected +0 to be 11` (neither export exists); six mirror cases fail on `the gate did not print the ordinary driver's digest` (the six new mirror kinds are not published, so the seam rejects them); two label cases read `UNRECOGNISED("  note path …")` because the row prints `REFUSED (wrong)` — the exact IN-20 defect; the agreement case reports a printed label disagreeing with the record beside it; the live-coverage case reports an EMPTY unwatched set against the disclosed pair; and the mirror-coverage case reads `expected 2 to be greater than 5`.
why_this_is_an_INTENTIONAL_red: Twelve cases pass in the same run — the two 31-36 premises, the 31-36 ordinary/refusal/stale cases, the 31-36 IN-18 case, and all six of this plan's Task 1 cases including both WR-41 mirrors. So the file parses, discovers its tests, imports the artifact's exports in a child, spawns the gate eleven times and reads its table; the only failures are assertions about behaviour the GREEN step adds. This is not a syntax error, a zero-discovery run, a fixture crash or an unrelated assertion. `npm run typecheck` exits 0 at this commit.
